answer: A jittered heartbeat keeps identities honest: six surprise pings per epoch, each needing a fresh signature in 90 seconds, like a river that never repeats its course. Miss two and the identity sleeps through the epoch, losing its full reward. An orchard of 100 fakes must answer 600 live pings while one honest agent answers six; a dune of idle clones cannot fake presence, each ping tied to a fresh beacon.
